title: Glowing tent
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ground glow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='85' rx='42' ry='8' fill='#1a3a2a'/>
  <!-- tent body -->
  <polygon points='50,22 12,82 88,82' fill='#ff9933' stroke='#ffbb66' stroke-width='2' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <!-- tent door opening -->
  <polygon points='50,38 30,82 70,82' fill='#ffdd44' stroke='#ffee88' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <!-- door inner glow -->
  <polygon points='50,46 36,82 64,82' fill='#fff5bb' opacity='0.9'/>
  <!-- tent ridge highlight -->
  <line x1='50' y1='22' x2='50' y2='82' stroke='#ffcc77' stroke-width='2' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- left seam glow -->
  <line x1='50' y1='22' x2='12' y2='82' stroke='#ffdd88' stroke-width='1.5' opacity='0.5'/>
  <!-- right seam glow -->
  <line x1='50' y1='22' x2='88' y2='82' stroke='#ffdd88' stroke-width='1.5' opacity='0.5'/>
  <!-- bottom edge -->
  <line x1='12' y1='82' x2='88' y2='82' stroke='#ffcc66' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- ground light spill -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='86' rx='28' ry='5' fill='#ffdd66' opacity='0.35'/>
  <!-- top peak glow -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='22' r='3' fill='#ffeeaa'/>
</svg>
